    ∃ K : Subgroup (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ, Nat.card K = p := by

  have h_le := Nat.le_self_pow hn.ne' a

  have hcard' : p ∣ Fintype.card (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ := by

  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card p hcard'

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem cyclic_subgroup_card_prime_units {a n p : ℕ}
    (ha : a > 1) (hn : n > 0) (hp : p.Prime)
    (hcard : p ∣ Nat.card ((ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ)) :
    ∃ K : Subgroup (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ, Nat.card K = p := by
  classical
  have hpow : 1 < a ^ n := Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) (by omega)
  have hpos : 0 < a ^ n - 1 := by omega
  have hne : a ^ n - 1 ≠ 0 := by omega
  haveI : NeZero (a ^ n - 1) := ⟨hne⟩
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  
  have hF1 : p ^ 1 ∣ Nat.card ((ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ) := by
    simpa [pow_one] using hcard
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime (p := p) (n := 1) (G := (ZMod (a ^ n - 1))ˣ) hF1
  exact ⟨K, by simpa [pow_one] using hK⟩
